expanded_prompts.sm-winged-009-normal-attempt001.txt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one original, gentle fantasy creature for a hand-drawn 2D creature-raising game.
Create exactly ONE new full-body creature, not based on any existing character.
Locked v2 anatomy and materials: Exactly one flat rounded seed-shaped body with matte dry-leaf texture, not a triangular pyramid. Exactly one centered round eye on the front. Exactly four wide softly rounded wings without crease lines, each separate and countable. Exactly four short rounded legs, all visible. Exactly one short rounded leaf-shaped tail without any notch. No arms or ears.
Locked pose and personality: Hover just before landing, front two legs lightly bent, all four wings spread at differing gentle angles, face image-right. Calm balanced posture.
Palette roles primary / secondary / dark accent, respectively: #D79E52 / #6E8375 / #F1D8A8. Preserve the primary color on the main body, secondary on scales or tufts or soft wings, dark accent for contours and eyes.
Mandatory identifiers: flat rounded seed body with one centered eye; four wide rounded wings without folds; four short legs and one rounded leaf tail without notch.
Style: clear variable-width dark colored outline, restrained three-step cel shading, soft upper-left lighting, modest tactile material cues, appealing proportions. No photorealism or glossy 3D rendering.
Composition: full body, light top-down three-quarter view. Output MUST be exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels RGBA PNG. Center the creature inside the central 80 percent of the square; its longest extent 800–850 pixels and at least 80 completely transparent pixels on each edge. Show all specified appendages distinctly, no cropping.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no drawn checkerboard, no ground, no shadow, no glow. Depict only the creature; no habitat, rocks, leaves, props, clothing, scenery, text, letters, logos, watermarks, frames or extra anatomy.
